technicalBlocker: BHUMI's current public page delegates the map to a separate console. The console HTML and JavaScript were reachable, but no public WMS/WFS parcel endpoint was exposed in the inspected assets. A known BHUMI proxy capability route redirected then returned 404. The city SIHANDAL site is described publicly as a government asset WebGIS, not a cadastral parcel source; its TLS certificate was expired during the direct GET, so no exception was used.
remainingUncertainty: A parcel layer may be available interactively inside the current BHUMI console or through an authenticated/separately published ATR/BPN service. SIHANDAL may expose government asset polygons, but that would not establish citywide cadastral coverage or a cadastral native identity.
